
Verified reference code from earlier tasks, most relevant first.

Record 1.

entry ndigits
params u64
ret u8

Helper: number of decimal digits of n (at least 1), a bounded divide-by-10 loop.

```
fn ndigits n ulong to uchar
k = uchar 1
while ge n 10 bound 20
n = div n 10
k = add k 1
end
ret k
end
```

Record 2.

entry sat_sub
params u32 u32
ret u32

Helper: saturating subtraction, a - b clamped at 0.

```
fn sat_sub a uint b uint to uint
if ge a b
ret sub a b
end
ret 0
end
```

Record 3.

entry range_sum
params u32 u32
ret u64

Helper: sum of lo..hi inclusive with a bounded while loop; 0 when lo > hi.

```
fn range_sum lo uint hi uint to ulong
s = ulong 0
i = lo
while le i hi bound 100000
s = add s ulong i
i = add i 1
end
ret s
end
```
